jsonLd.description:
Located steps from the Joyce–Collingwood SkyTrain Station, this thoughtfully designed rental apartments offers direct access to the best of Vancouver while providing a welcoming place to call home. Surrounded by local cafés, parks, international dining, and everyday conveniences, residents can enjoy the energy of a vibrant neighbourhood with the ease of rapid transit at their doorstep. Featuring contemporary interiors, premium amenities, and spaces designed for work, wellness, and connection, Joyce² delivers a balanced urban lifestyle in one of Vancouver’s most dynamic communities.
